issues.detail: The Hebrew 'וַֽיַּעֲנֵנִי' means 'and he answered me' (positive), but the Chinese renders it as '他卻不應允' ('he did not answer'), reversing the meaning. The Hebrew states 'If I call and he answers me, I would not believe that he listens to my voice' — the Chinese incorrectly negates the answering.
